boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten verified CSUB spaces for independent work, collaborative sessions, computer access, and subject-specific academic support.

cards.entity_name: Walter W. Stiern Library Group Study Space
cards.title: Set Up a Group Session Among Booths and Outlets
cards.subtitle: Quiet rooms and collaborative seating inside Walter W. Stiern Library
cards.notes: Bring a charged laptop and choose between a quiet room, a comfortable booth, or a table equipped with outlets for group work.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-built library collaboration area with several seating formats and convenient device charging.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB reports that the library's group study space includes quiet rooms, comfortable booths, and tables with several electrical outlets.
cards.source_title: Fab Lab Annex Among Three New Additions to CSUB Library
cards.access_notes: Use during Walter W. Stiern Library operating hours; consult the library's current hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Walter W. Stiern Library 24-Hour Study Space
cards.title: Keep Working After the Main Library Day Ends
cards.subtitle: A designated round-the-clock study option at Stiern Library
cards.notes: Use this designated space when your work extends beyond regular library hours, and carry your RunnerCard in case entry controls apply.
cards.short_summary: The library identifies a dedicated 24-hour space for study outside its ordinary service schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: The university library dean stated that a 24-hour study space is available at Walter W. Stiern Library.
cards.source_title: Staff Q and A: Dean of University Libraries Sandra Bozarth
cards.access_notes: The official source identifies this as a 24-hour study space; verify current entry and RunnerCard requirements with the library.

cards.title: Work at a Mac or Windows Lab Station
cards.subtitle: Open academic computer lab in Stiern Library, Lower Level Room 1
cards.notes: Choose this lab when coursework needs campus software, Mac or Windows hardware, scanning, or printing; bring a RunnerCard for student services.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level academic lab combining computer workstations with printing and related technology services.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB identifies Lab A as an open academic computer lab in Walter W. Stiern Library Lower Level Room 1 with Mac and Windows platforms and student printing.
cards.source_title: Lab A | California State University, Bakersfield
cards.access_notes: Open to CSUB students, staff, and faculty but not the public; the posted normal schedule is Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–8 p.m. and Friday 9 a.m.–5 p.m., with summer closure noted.

cards.entity_name: Multicultural Alliance and Gender Equity Center
cards.title: Use a Study Room or Communal Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student-support center with several work-space formats
cards.notes: Choose a study room for focused work or settle into a communal lounge; ask center staff which rooms are open when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: MAGEC combines reservable-style study environments, lounge space, computers, and an on-site book collection.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB's current catalog says MAGEC provides a computer lab, study rooms, communal lounge areas, three club rooms, and Jai's Library.
cards.source_title: Student Affairs and Strategic Enrollment Management
cards.access_notes: Intended for students using MAGEC programs and resources; contact the center to confirm current room availability and access procedures.

cards.title: Bring a Draft for Focused Writing Support
cards.subtitle: In-person workspace for writing, literature, and citation help
cards.notes: Arrive with the assignment prompt and a specific goal—brainstorming, structure, revision, editing, or citations—to make the session productive.
cards.short_summary: A writing-focused learning environment where enrolled students can develop work at any stage with trained tutors.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB says the Writing Resource Center offers free tutoring and support to currently enrolled students across all subjects and stages of writing.
cards.source_title: Writing Resource Center | California State University, Bakersfield
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled CSUB students; contact wrc@csub.edu for an appointment. The page posts Summer 2026 in-person and Zoom hours Monday–Thursday, noon–5 p.m.

cards.title: Work Through Calculus and Upper-Division Math
cards.subtitle: Science III, Room 208
cards.notes: Bring the problem set and your attempted work, then use the drop-in format to ask targeted questions about calculus, statistics, or advanced math.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated math workspace offering no-appointment tutoring during fall and spring terms.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB locates the Mathematics Tutoring Center in Science III Room 208 and states that tutoring is free, requires no appointment, and operates in fall and spring.
cards.access_notes: No appointment is needed. The center operates during fall and spring, including finals week, and closes during winter and summer sessions; check posted hours.

cards.title: Untangle a General-Education Math Assignment
cards.subtitle: Science III, Room 117
cards.notes: Take your notes, calculator, and unfinished problems to this separate GE-focused center, then check the posted schedule before crossing campus.
cards.short_summary: A distinct Science III tutoring room for general-education mathematics support without an appointment.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB identifies the GE Mathematics Tutoring Center in Science III Room 117 and states that its tutoring is free and requires no appointment.
cards.access_notes: No appointment is needed. It operates during fall and spring, including finals week, and is closed during winter and summer sessions; consult current hours.

cards.entity_name: Social Sciences and Education Tutoring Center
cards.title: Build a Focused Social-Science Work Session
cards.subtitle: Education Building, Room 235 on the second floor
cards.notes: Bring course materials and book ahead through RunnerConnect when possible; walk-ins can still use the in-person center when capacity allows.
cards.short_summary: An in-person tutoring environment supporting five social-science and education subject areas.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB locates the SSE Tutoring Center in Education Building Room 235 and lists support for criminal justice, kinesiology, political science, psychology, and sociology.
cards.source_title: Tutoring Center | California State University, Bakersfield
cards.access_notes: In-person and Zoom tutoring are offered. Walk-ins are available, but the university highly encourages making an appointment at least 24 hours ahead through RunnerConnect.

cards.entity_name: Business and Public Administration Tutoring Center
cards.title: Settle In With an Accounting or Economics Problem
cards.subtitle: Business Development Center A, Room 218
cards.notes: Check the subject schedule first, then bring the relevant textbook, assignment, and your own calculations to the correct in-person tutor block.
cards.short_summary: A business-school tutoring room with subject-specific sessions rather than a single all-purpose schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB locates the BPA tutoring office in Business Development Center Building A Room 218 and publishes in-person subject tutoring schedules.
cards.source_title: Tutoring Center | California State University, Bakersfield
cards.access_notes: Check the center's current term schedule because availability varies by subject and tutor; contact bpatc@csub.edu with access questions.

cards.entity_name: Student Housing East Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve a Small Room With Housemates
cards.subtitle: Two resident study rooms accessed through the Community Center desk
cards.notes: Gather no more than four residents, take student IDs and mailbox keys to the Community Center desk, and request an access card before studying.
cards.short_summary: Two controlled-access housing study rooms designed for small resident groups and time-limited reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB's housing handbook documents two group study rooms for residents, with access cards checked out at the Community Center desk, a four-person limit, and reservations of up to two hours during high demand.
cards.source_title: CSUB Student Housing & Residence Life Handbook
cards.access_notes: Residents only. Bring the student ID and mailbox key of each user to the Community Center desk; posted hours govern access, and high-demand reservations may be limited to two hours.

warnings: The Student Housing East room procedures come from the university's 2023–2024 residence-life handbook; residents should confirm that the desk process remains current.
Several tutoring pages vary by academic term, so users should verify the live schedule before visiting.
Exact room-level coordinates and verified direct map URLs were unavailable, so those fields are null.
